parameters.query: SELECT ticket_number, id, status, priority FROM tickets WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid AND status IN ('open','pending','assigned') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO tickets (customer_id, conversation_id, subject, status, priority, intent, confidence, sentiment, ai_summary, escalation_reason, last_message) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, 'open', $4, $5, $6::numeric, $7, $8, $9, $10) RETURNING ticket_number, id, status, priority;
